long_description:
Acquired by Asana (NYSE:ASAN) in May 2026.

StackAI partners with enterprises to deploy custom AI agents to automate their most complex back-office workflows. Teams at BAE Systems, Monzo, Morgan & Morgan, and Goodwill work with StackAI to bring AI Agents to their operations.

Enterprises use StackAI no-code to automate large compliance audits, knowledge work, legal intake, due diligence research, and insurance claim underwriting.
name: StackAI
